$comment: Ralos' Rise prayer training (docs/ralos-rise.md): the exposed altar blesses bones and wine, a chisel breaks blessed bones into shards, the Teomat's libation bowl takes the shards for Prayer XP. Names are gamevals. Bones, their blessed form and their shard count are in bones.json (`blessed`, `shards`). Messages, sequences, sounds and varbits are from rsprox recordings 1104, 1141, 1157 and 4054 (rev 237, Leagues VI) unless their `_` note says ours; amounts and levels from the Wiki (Exposed altar, Libation bowl, Blessed bone shards).
_mesboxChatType: A message box's line goes in the chat log too, as this type (the recordings' `message_game type=mesbox`; plugins/interface/clans/Guests.Clans.js).

breakdown._intervalTicks: Wiki (Blessed bone shards): one at once, then one every 4 ticks; recording 1104 tick 29892 (+0, +4).
breakdown._extra: Already blessed, so broken down without the altar (Wiki: Sun-kissed bones, Blessed bone statuette).

bowl._varbits: The bowl (multiloc varlamore_libation_bowl) shows varlamore_libation_bowl_empty (Fill) at charge 0 and varlamore_libation_bowl_full (Sacrifice, Check) at 1 and up: its transforms are [empty] with full as the default. winetype is 0 for blessed wine and 1 for blessed sunfire wine (recording 4054 tick 4072).
bowl._intervalTicks: Wiki (Pay-to-play Prayer training): 4 ticks an action when left alone, every tick when clicked; recording 1141 ticks 6688-6704.

_messages: Ours (no recording or Wiki text): altarLevel, superiorLevel, breakdownLevel, noChisel, bowlLevel and check. The recordings show the bless lines only for 7 to 24 items, so they are used for one too.
